title: ganglion model catalogue
description: The providers a node uses and their models (GANGLION_MODELS_FILE; spec 7.3, R-PRV-5, ADR-0021). The Go loader router/rules.LoadCatalog is the validator at start; this schema is for editors, docs and the agent.

providers.description: Model backends. List one or several.

models.description: Models the router may pick, at least one.

name.description: Unique name; models refer to it.

type.description: openai: Chat Completions (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, …). claude-cli: an unmodified claude -p on this machine.

base_url.description: openai: the API base, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

key_env.description: openai: the environment variable (or <NAME>_FILE) that holds the API key. Keys never go in this file. May be empty only for a localhost base_url.

command.description: claude-cli: the binary, default claude on PATH.

name.description: The model id the provider expects, e.g. haiku or deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

tier.description: People's messages try smart first, crons and compaction cheap first; the other tier is the fallback.

tools.description: The model can call tools. claude-cli models cannot yet (M3b).

local.description: Data stays on the operator's hardware; privacy: local-only tasks use only these.

context.description: Context window in tokens; 100000 or more counts as long.

price_in.description: USD per million input tokens; 0 for subscription and local models.

latency_ms.description: Typical latency; ranks models of equal price.
